summary:
[  edit  ]
The Reorder  DAT  allows you to reorder the rows and columns of the input table. You can also use In Specified Order option to get duplicate copies of rows and columns.

parameters.label: Reorder
parameters.name: reorder
parameters.description: ⊞  - This parameter allows you to reorder either rows or columns.

parameters.label: Method
parameters.name: method
parameters.description: ⊞  - Specify how to reorder the table.

parameters.label: Reverse
parameters.name: reverse
parameters.description: Reverse the order rows or columns.

parameters.label: Replace by Names
parameters.name: replacenames
parameters.description: Copy a row or column in the input table specified in From to the row or column specified in To.  Rows or Columns are specified by names.

parameters.label: Replace by Indices
parameters.name: replaceindices
parameters.description: Copy a row or column in the input table specified in From to the row or column specified in To.  Rows or Columns are specified by numbers.

parameters.label: Swap by Names
parameters.name: swapnames
parameters.description: Swap a row or column specified in From with the row or column specified in To. Rows or Columns are specified by names. Swaps are cumulative.

parameters.label: Swap by Indices
parameters.name: swapindices
parameters.description: Swap a row or column specified in From with the row or column specified in To. Rows or Columns are specified by numbers. Swaps are cumulative.

parameters.label: In Specified Order by Name
parameters.name: specifyname
parameters.description: Copy the rows or columns in the specified order by name. Any row or column not listed will be appended in input order. You can specify a row or column more than once to get multiple copies of it.

parameters.label: In Specified Order by Index
parameters.name: specifyindex
parameters.description: Copy the rows or columns in the specified order by index. Any row or column not listed will be appended in input order. You can specify a row or column more than once to get multiple copies of it.

parameters.label: Before
parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The rows or columns to copy or swap from.

parameters.label: After
parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The rows or columns to copy or swap to.

parameters.label: Order
parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The order of input rows and columns to copy.

parameters.label: Delete Unspecified
parameters.name: delete
parameters.description: Only available when Method is 'In Specified Order by Name' or 'In Specified Order by Index'. It will delete any row/column not listed in the Order parameter.

parameters.label: Language
parameters.name: language
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select how the  DAT  decides which script language to operate on.

parameters.label: Input
parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses the inputs script language.

parameters.label: Node
parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses it's own script language.

parameters.label: Edit/View Extension
parameters.name: extension
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select the file extension this  DAT  should expose to external editors.

parameters.label: dat
parameters.name: dat
parameters.description: various common file extensions.

parameters.label: From Language
parameters.name: languageext
parameters.description: pick extension from DATs script language.

parameters.label: Custom Extension
parameters.name: customext
parameters.description: Specify a custom extension.

parameters.label: Custom Extension
parameters.name: customext
parameters.description: Specifiy the custom extension.

parameters.label: Word Wrap
parameters.name: wordwrap
parameters.description: ⊞  - Enable Word Wrap for Node Display.

parameters.label: Input
parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses the inputs setting.

parameters.label: On
parameters.name: on
parameters.description: Turn on Word Wrap.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: off
parameters.description: Turn off Word Wrap.

parameters.label: num_rows
parameters.description: Number of rows in this  DAT .

parameters.label: num_cols
parameters.description: Number of columns in this  DAT .

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.
